title: Hale API v1 — DNA reads and optional practice command adapter
description: Implemented read contract and optional dna.practice.propose.v1 adapter profile. Provider absence remains read-only. Scripted command conformance does not establish live native durable admission, authorization or recovery.

Practice.description: Named Practice catalog row; exact id lookup also returns recognized unnamed Knowledge and retirement candidates using the same canonical receipt and visibility validation. Generic exact candidates do not enter the named Practice list.

read_only.description: False when any available and authorized command is configured, including independently granted Organization proposal/source Review or Knowledge commands. True implies every named write flag is false.

KnowledgeInt64.description: Canonical signed Int64 decimal string, exactly -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807. Validators must assert int64-decimal format.

principal.description: Untrusted expected identity, compared with the authenticated context before provider dispatch; never grants or selects authority.
Untrusted expected identity, compared with the authenticated context before provider dispatch; never grants or selects authority.

Usage.description: Model calls summed from their model.called evidence rows: an attempt's own, or a task's with every task under it, by position (the graph's position id) and by backend/model. Counters are native integers as decimal strings.

id.description: Exact sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex endpoint identity. Native adapter enforces syntax and target equality with one endpoint.

KnowledgeLinkCommandRequest.description: Native adapter enforces UTF-8 byte limits, exact application/expected principal equality and digest endpoint syntax. Exact Record-head admission; graph generations are read provenance, not command preconditions. No normalization of rationale or relationship label.

edge_id.description: Exact ID computed from the directed from_id, to_id and rel tuple. The native adapter checks equality; labels and reverse edges remain distinct.

KnowledgeUnlinkCommandRequest.description: Record-fenced removal of an exact directed stored tuple. Requires its exact edge_id alongside endpoints and label; no route, generation or visibility assumption establishes absence.

id.description: Exact requested binding target; equals arguments.target. Owning policy must explicitly grant the author/target pair.

KnowledgeNodeProposeCommandRequest.description: Durable Knowledge node propose request. Native adapter checks exact app, principal and Record head, decoded UTF-8 bounds (text 8192 bytes, rationale 2048 bytes), encoded body 98304 bytes and target/subject equality. The owning service validates explicit author/target scope and creates a digest-pinned Review; admission does not activate or project a node.

KnowledgeNodeReviseCommandRequest.description: Durable Knowledge node revise request. Native adapter checks exact app, principal and Record head, decoded UTF-8 bounds (text 8192 bytes, rationale 2048 bytes), encoded body 98304 bytes and target/subject equality. The owning service validates explicit author/target scope and creates a digest-pinned Review; admission does not activate or project a node.

KnowledgeNodeRetireCommandRequest.description: Durable Knowledge node retire request. Native adapter checks exact app, principal and Record head, decoded UTF-8 bounds (text 8192 bytes, rationale 2048 bytes), encoded body 98304 bytes and target/subject equality. The owning service validates explicit author/target scope and creates a digest-pinned Review; admission does not activate or project a node.

KnowledgeEdgeCommandReceipt.description: Durable Record effect only; no graph projection success. Adapter verifies scoped command identity, source and exact evidence; on POST also fingerprint, requested Record head and visible edge identity. Sequence is less than captured source revision. No rationale or endpoint content is returned. Operation is the original stored link or unlink. A removal receipt names the removed edge identity; it does not prove graph absence.

KnowledgeNodeCommandReceipt.description: Durable Knowledge node admission and native proposal/Review/adoption evidence. No graph projection success is implied. Receipt reasons contain only service-controlled summaries. Exact source, identity and fingerprint checks remain in the adapter.

KnowledgeBindCommandRequest.description: Exact existing item/locus tuple; author/target are requested loci, never authentication. Native byte bounds and tuple equality apply.

KnowledgeUnbindCommandRequest.description: Exact existing item/locus tuple; author/target are requested loci, never authentication. Native byte bounds and tuple equality apply.

KnowledgeBindingCommandReceipt.description: Exact binding proposal, Review and Record effect evidence; graph observation is separate.

KnowledgeBindingCandidateDocument.description: The native reader validates digest syntax, exact canonical bytes/hash, tuple identity, captured grant and originating Record request; schema checks the closed document shape.

anyOf.description: Exact canonical JSON string; parse only according to its explicit binding or edge discriminator. Native reader verifies document hash and originating admitted command/grant, independently of graph projection.

candidate_commit.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

anyOf.description: document is the literal JSON OrganizationSourceCandidateDocument read. A separately configured Organization recovery grant is required; it does not enable publishing.

KnowledgeReviewedEdgeCommandReceipt.description: Reviewed relationship proposal, exact Review and Record effect evidence. Required relationship object distinguishes this from the unchanged direct receipt; graph observation is separate.

KnowledgeEdgeCandidateDocument.description: Exact native canonical document, fourteen fields. Native reader validates digest, tuple, captured grant, Record author/application, endpoint visibility and historical tuple basis.

source_head.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

module_digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

commit.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

parent.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

receipt_digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

verification.description: receipt_digest authenticates the retained native diff JSON; digest authenticates the distinct returned OrganizationSemanticDiff projection document. They are not interchangeable.

OrganizationSourceCandidateDocument.description: Immutable evidence assembled from the original admitted native request and retained Git objects. Module strings are exact UTF-8 bytes bounded to 16384 natively; each retained diff is bounded to 131072 bytes and verified by SHA256. Git commit identity is distinct from module digest. This is a read document, not a native publication or activation receipt.

OrganizationSemanticDiff.description: Deliberately selected native semantic read: classification, exact summary counts and declaration identity/change only. It omits compiler locations and raw contracts, effects, law details and diagnostics; counts do not provide those omitted details.

source_head.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

module_digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

OrganizationCommandRequest.description: Fixed-module source preparation. Native validation enforces exact five-field base, 16384 decoded UTF8 source bytes, 2048 rationale bytes and independent 32768 encoded HTTP bytes. Expected principal does not confer authority. Public enablement is separate from recognition of this wire.

OrganizationCommandCapabilities.description: Separate Organization authority; ordinary Practice/Review permissions do not imply source permission. Availability reflects native deployment enablement; authorization can remain true while unavailable. command_origin pins the permitted exact origin.

OrganizationReviewCommandCapabilities.description: Separate Organization authority; ordinary Practice/Review permissions do not imply source permission. Availability reflects native deployment enablement; authorization can remain true while unavailable. command_origin pins the permitted exact origin.

OrganizationCommandReceipt.description: Proposal creation stays succeeded independently of later Review/application/handoff. Exact native application and restart-handoff evidence are reported separately; activation remains unknown in this profile. No source or raw refusal prose is repeated.

OrganizationImpactCounts.description: Canonical unsigned decimal strings. Runtime invariants: open_workflow_tasks <= workflow_tasks; open_legacy_tasks <= legacy_tasks; handed_tasks <= open_legacy_tasks. These cross-field comparisons are checked by the native projection and consumer, not expressed by this JSON Schema subset.

OrganizationSourceImpact.description: Exact source Review at one current Record head. Counts cover the whole application, with no inferred position binding or admission fence. none_observed does not authorize publication or establish that no live responsibility exists outside this read profile.

assignment_digest.description: Exact native sha256 digest of ordered relevant Task lifecycle facts; syntax and native history are verified by the owning reader.

assignee.description: Exact requested current recorded assignee, echoed only when filtered; not owner or position membership.

TaskCommandRequest.description: Exact Task assignment preconditions; native decoding enforces 256 UTF8 identity bytes and an independent 32768 encoded request-byte limit. Expected principal confers no authority. No caller-supplied actor, obligation, acceptance or completion outcome.

TaskCreateCommandTarget.description: Raising work targets the application's Record: the target id is the application id, since the Task is minted by the organism after the ask is admitted.

TaskCreateCommandRequest.description: The ask `hale dna ask` makes, raised from the face: an outcome (natively at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes, control bytes preserved) for a position, conditioned on the Record head it was prepared against. The asker is the authenticated principal; the expected principal confers no authority. No caller-supplied intent id, from, via or Task id.

TaskCreateCommandReceipt.description: Raising work succeeds once its intent.requested row is in the Record; the subject digest is the Record head the request was prepared against. `task_create` re-derives the organism's answer on every read: requested until it answers, offered, refused, or born with the Task id. An uncertain append names no intent.

AttemptEvidenceCall.description: One model call a leg made under the attempt, as its evidence: the fields of a model.called row. Journaled on the attempt id by the owner, so tokens per task hold out of process.

AttemptClaimCommandRequest.description: A leg claims one admitted, outstanding attempt of the kind it performs (GH #946): needing nothing beyond its capabilities, of a data class it may see, under an owner it works for. The claim is memory's, keyed on the attempt id with this TTL; the lease comes back as a value. Conditioned on the Record head the request was prepared against.

arguments.description: The outcome, with the hat the leg wore when it wore one: the five hat fields together (hat_digest, hat_head, hat_watermark, prompt_digest, renderer) or none of them.

AttemptOutcomeCommandRequest.description: A leg hands back the outcome of the attempt it claimed, under its lease (GH #946): the disposition, the result or a reference to it, the calls it made as evidence, and the receipts to file (a protected body goes to memory alone). The owner still settles; a stale or duplicate outcome is refused with the reason.

AttemptCommandOutcome.description: What a claim or an outcome reads back: the attempt and its lease (holder, token, until) as a value, the outcome's state as the owner settles it, or the refusal with its reason.

AttemptRenewCommandRequest.description: A leg extends the lease it holds on an attempt (GH #946): memory's claim is taken again by its holder, which keeps the token, and another attempt.claimed row names the later until.

AttemptReleaseCommandRequest.description: A leg gives the lease back without an outcome (GH #946): memory's claim released, an attempt.released row naming why; the attempt awaits another leg.

FrictionCommandRequest.description: A position files what got in its way (GH #946): a friction.filed row under the attempt it was met on, else the position; a fact nobody admits.

Hat.description: The hat (GH #946): one Work's context as structure, never a prompt. A point-in-time render fenced to the Record head and memory's projection watermark; the digest is sha256 over the canonical body with the digest itself left out, and is what an attempt, a receipt and a tape key on. Positions are the graph's position:<name> ids.

PersonCommandRequest.description: Retire the exact person and move every responsibility in the reviewed native plan atomically. Empty successor is valid only with no held Tasks. Source memberships are unchanged. Native parsing enforces UTF8 byte bounds.

HeadOperationName.description: The closed set of head operations; every one is version 1 and is the CLI verb, run detached by the head.

active.description: The attached project's application_id, or empty when detached.

HeadIdentity.description: Who answered: the head profile, the trusted-local principal every command runs as, and the active project. Not a Record source: head routes carry no record_id.

HeadEnvelope.description: The envelope of the four head routes. A Record envelope's source object is not permitted here.

HeadBody.description: The local body as the head sees it: its own child, or `external` when `<root>/.hale/dna/org.pid` is alive and not a head child.

HeadCredentials.description: Names only: the credentials the catalog names, the operator's file sources, and the needed names set in the head's environment. No value ever crosses this wire.

busy.description: The command_id of the running receipt, or empty.

HeadAuthority.description: Whether each per-project policy file is present and decodes for this identity under the Record's trust.

HeadProject.description: One registered project. The five detail fields (authority, connections, handoffs, secrets, receipts) are present only on the `?id=` read; the projections are read in-process from the Record and touch no network.

SecretSource.description: Where the run script reads a secret: a 0600 one-line file under the operator's sources directory, or an environment variable the shell reads. The head never reads the value.

HeadCommandArguments.description: The closed superset of every operation's arguments; each operation admits only its own keys (the allowlists of the head README), and a `value` key is never one of them.

application_id.description: The attached project's application_id; empty only for dna.project.create, init, attach and forget.

principal.description: Untrusted expected identity, compared with the head's principal before anything is recorded; never grants authority.

HeadCommandRequest.description: One head command (dna.head-command/1). The head validates the shape before recording; a shape error is 400 invalid_command, never a receipt.

HeadRun.description: How the command executed: a detached run, the long-lived body child, or inline in the POST. `external` says whether a deadline yields outcome_unknown (true) or failed.

HeadCommandReceipt.description: The fold of the receipt journal for one command: recorded, then admitted or refused, then running, then succeeded, failed or outcome_unknown. A deadline on an external verb is outcome_unknown with evidence, never failed.
